dct_description_sm: A citation to the associated publication will be added once the manuscript is submitted and published.

This data set contains measurements of dissolved silicic acid, particulate biogenic silica, and associated silica uptake rates from oceanographic stations in the Northeast Pacific. The data were collected in collaboration with the Canadian DFO Line P program and the NASA and NSF-funded EXPORTS project.
